stem.x: There exists a main process and the two (2) interrupt processes A and B, as shown in the table below. Multiplex interrupts are permitted. When interrupts A and B occur with the timing shown in the diagram below, how many milliseconds (ms) can the main process use the CPU during the time period between 0 ms and 5 ms? Here, the overhead from calling an interrupt process and resuming from it can be ignored.
